title: Inspect the ECG result exports
description: You follow model parameters and result arrays into the example's artifacts.

steps.description: You create artifacts and save one NumPy archive. Its entries include model parameters, state results, window indices, scaling parameters, and the signal arrays.
You define save_plot to draw a series, save its figure, and close it. When x is omitted, the helper uses sample indices.

steps.question: Do these two saved plots use sample indices or the supplied time array?
steps.answer: Both calls pass x=time, so the helper uses the supplied time array.

steps.description: You save ecg.png and p_artifact.png. The recorded listing contains both images and hmm_ecg_artifact_model_and_results.npz.
